name: Not Heaven
source:
Not Heaven is a short kinetic novel i made to practice in Ren'py, its like a short illustrated story book but with music and some effects

Featuring the story of a man guiding a lost kid
Inspired in a song (good luck finding what song it is)

[From [url=https://borelight.itch.io/not-heaven] itch.io[/url]]
